title: Silver chloride–poly-2-chlorobenzeneamine complex nanocomposite as photoelectrode for photoelectrochemical hydrogen gas generation from seawater
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35543-35552
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03341A, Paper
Open Access

Fahad Abdulaziz, Mohamed Rabia, Mohamed Zayed, Salman Latif, Yassin A. Jeilani, Raja Rama Devi Patel, Hussein A. Elsayed, Ashour M. Ahmed
An innovative silver chloride–poly(2-chlorobenzeneamine) (AgCl–P2CBA) complex nanocomposite is developed through a one-step chemical synthesis route for efficient and sustainable hydrogen production from seawater.
